# Vetta 0.6.18
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-24 -->

## English

### New

- The ⌘T panel is now called the Launcher, with its own page in Settings: a preview, a "Try it now" button, what it can do, and a place to change its shortcut. Press the shortcut again or Esc to close it.
- Settings → Archived now lets you select several projects and unarchive or delete them in one go.

### Improvements

- Settings → Workspaces now explains at the top how workspaces group the sidebar, how to switch between them, and that your project files are never moved.

### Fixes

- With the Launcher open, ⌘N (or your custom shortcut) now closes it and starts a new session instead of doing nothing.
- Moving through the Launcher with the arrow keys no longer hides the selected row behind the buttons at the bottom, and hovering no longer makes the list scroll.

## 中文

### 新增

- ⌘T 面板正式改名「启动器」，设置里新增「启动器」页：有示意预览、「立即试试」按钮和它能做的事，也能直接改唤起快捷键；再按一次快捷键或按 Esc 即可关闭。
- 设置「已归档」页支持多选，可一次取消归档或删除多个项目。

### 改进

- 设置「工作空间」页顶部加上说明：工作空间如何给侧栏分组、怎么切换，以及不会挪动你的项目文件。

### 修复

- 启动器打开时按 ⌘N（或你改过的快捷键）会关掉面板并新建会话，不再没反应。
- 在启动器里用方向键往下选时，选中行不会再被底部按钮挡住；鼠标悬停也不会再让列表跟着滚动。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.17...v0.6.18
